title: TaskReport (message) v1
description: runner->hub: the terminal frame for a task. Wraps a stapel-taskspecs TaskReport (validated by that library, including its mandatory five-component usage split) and places it in the per-task progress stream via seq. This is the message envelope; the report payload's shape is owned by stapel-taskspecs.

report.description: A stapel-taskspecs TaskReport object (status done|blocked|failed, controls, usage, ...). Validated against the taskspecs schema by TaskReportMessage.validate().

seq.description: Sequence number in the runner's per-task outbound stream (continues the progress numbering).
